The purchaser email domain 'verizon.net' for transaction 3660127 has been used 19 times previously on card C06220-K1.

case.summary: Verdict is fraud at 0.92 probability due to an undocumented coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave affecting three transactions (3660125, 3660126, 3660127) for an exposure of $2,166.71. This pattern, identified after an analyst request, and the card's history of five prior confirmed fraud cases were decisive. A block of card C06220-K1 is recommended (L1), and a suspicious activity report is recommended (L2).

sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report is filed for an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern, internal case ID AC-HHF-002, opened 2017-01-19. The activity involves customer C06220, associated with Visa credit card C06220-K1, and 13 connected cards: C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05061-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, C11543-K2. Between 2017-01-17 and 2017-01-19, three suspicious online transactions occurred on card C06220-K1, totaling $2,166.71. On 2017-01-17 at 19:58, an online transaction for $637.13 (ID 3660125) was made from region 330.0 using device 'SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536'. On 2017-01-18 at 19:48, an online transaction for $758.80 (ID 3660126) was made from region 384.0 using device 'SM-J700T1 | iOS 11.1.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536'. On 2017-01-19 at 18:18, the flagged online transaction for $770.78 (ID 3660127) was made from region 126.0 using device 'SM-J700T1 | NULL | NULL | NULL'. All these transactions involved new mobile devices behind an anonymous proxy, product code C, and show spoofed or rotated OS-browser telemetry, consistent with a coordinated fraud wave affecting the connected cards. This activity is considered suspicious because it forms part of an undocumented coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave, a pattern inconsistent with the cardholder's historical transaction behavior, despite prior transactions on the card up to $2,794.03 and a median transaction amount of $107.92 across 366 prior transactions. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on card C06220-K1, though six earlier closed cases were confirmed fraud but not reported; however, closed cases CC-3436 and CC-3419 on connected cards or related device profiles were confirmed fraud with reports filed. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Case AC-HHF-002 was opened, monitoring of connected cards was initiated, and the case was escalated to an analyst. A block of card C06220-K1 is recommended pending team-lead approval, and this report is recommended pending fraud-manager approval, for a total suspicious amount of $2,166.71.
